name: Realm: fogbound moors and crypts (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic moorland of fog and old stone photographed on location like a feature-film still - standing stones, ruined abbeys, crypts and black lakes, candle and lantern light in thick mist, cold desaturated colour and deep shadows; any magic is a faint cold glow
notes: The darkness homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/darkness/ (set components.realm).
